month.name: month
month.description: In HSE analytics, 'month' refers to a calendar period of approximately 30 days used for tracking, reporting, and analyzing safety observations, incidents, and trends. Monthly aggregation helps identify recurring issues, seasonal patterns, and the effectiveness of interventions within a specific timeframe.
examples: Five near misses were reported in the month of March.
Monthly safety inspection completed for April.
No lost time injuries occurred this month.
Monthly environmental audit identified two minor spills.
PPE compliance improved compared to last month.

quarter.name: quarter
quarter.description: In the HSE context, 'quarter' denotes a three-month period used for summarizing and comparing safety performance, incident rates, and compliance trends. Quarterly analysis supports management reviews, regulatory reporting, and strategic planning for health, safety, and environmental improvements.
examples: Quarterly incident rate decreased compared to previous quarter.
Quarterly review identified an increase in near misses.
No environmental violations reported this quarter.
Quarterly audit found three areas needing improvement.

year.name: year
year.description: In HSE analytics, 'year' refers to a twelve-month period used for comprehensive evaluation of safety performance, incident trends, and compliance with regulations. Annual data supports long-term planning, benchmarking, and reporting to stakeholders and authorities.
examples: Annual safety performance report shows a reduction in recordable injuries.
No major incidents occurred this year.
Lost time injury frequency rate improved over the year.
Year-to-date, all workers completed mandatory safety training.
